OPSC OCS Result 2026

OPSC OCS Prelims Result 2026 will determine candidate eligible for the next stages of the recruitment process i.e., Mains examination. Aspirants should keep their registration details ready to check result of OPSC OCS Prelims once released. The Commission will announce the list of shortlisted candidates online. Further instructions regarding mains examination will be announced after the result declaration

OPSC OCS Result 2026 Overview

OPSC OCS Exam 2026 was conducted on 7 June 2026 for recruitment to Group A & Group B posts. The OPSC OCS Prelims result is expected to be released in July 2026 on the official website @opsc.gov.in. Candidates who qualify Prelims exams will be eligible to appear for mains exam. Candidates can refer to the following table for important details

Particulars Details
Organization Name Odisha Public Service Commission (OPSC)
Exam Name Odisha Civil Service Examination 2025 (OCS)
Advertisement No. 05 of 2025–26
Posts Group A and Group B
Vacancies 465
Result Mode Online
OPSC OCS Expected Result Date July 2026
OPSC OCS Prelims Exam Date 7 June 2026
Selection Process
  • Prelims
  • Mains
  • Interview
Official Website opsc.gov.in

OPSC OCS Prelims Result Download PDF Link

The Prelims OPSC OCS Result PDF is expected to be released in July 2026 on the official website @opsc.gov.in. Candidates can download the result PDF and check their qualifying status. The PDF will contain roll numbers of shortlisted candidates. A direct download will be provided here once the result is announced

Direct Link for OPSC OCS Prelims Result 2026 Download PDF Link (TBA)

How to Download OPSC OCS Prelims Result 2026?

Candidates who appeared for prelims exam conducted on 7 June 2026 can check OPSC OCS results online through the official portal. Candidates can follow the steps given below to access and download the result

  • Visit the official website @opsc.gov.in
  • On the homepage click on the result notification link for OPSC OCS Prelims Result 2026
  • The result PDF will open on the screen
  • Check roll number or name in the PDF
  • Download the result PDF and save it for future reference

Details Mentioned on OPSC OCS Prelims Result 2026

The OPSC OCS Prelims Result 2026 contains important information regarding the performance in the examination. Candidates should carefully verify all the details mentioned in the result. In case of discrepancy candidates should contact the recruiting body for correction. The details mentioned in the result are as follows.

  • Name of the candidate
  • Roll Number
  • Category (UR/OBC/SCT/ST/EWS/PwBD)
  • Marks Obtained in the examination
  • Qualifying Status

What’s Next After OPSC OCS Prelims Result 2026?

Candidates who qualify OPSC OCS Prelims Result 2026 will be eligible to appear for Mains examination. Odisha Public Service Commission will release mains exam schedule and application details separately on its official website @opsc.gov.in. qualified candidates should begin preparing for descriptive mains exams. Those who clear mains stage will be shortlisted for Interview.

OPSC OCS Result 2026 Live Updates

Candidates can follow this page for latest updates on OPSC OCS Result 2026. We have provided live updates to help candidates stay informed about the result announcement, cut off marks and further stages of selection process. Any official notification released by Odisha Public Service Commission will be updated here promptly. Check below for live updates.

Result Announcement to End Candidates’ Wait

The release of the OPSC OCS Prelims Result 2026 will bring relief to thousands of candidates across Odisha. Successful candidates will then shift their complete focus toward preparing for the highly competitive Main Examination.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 06:25:15 PM IST

Merit-Based Selection Continues

The OPSC OCS recruitment process remains entirely merit-based. Candidates who qualify the Preliminary Examination will need to perform strongly in the Mains and Interview rounds to secure a final place in the merit list.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 06:15:26 PM IST

Candidates Review Previous Years’ Cutoffs

Many aspirants are analyzing previous OPSC OCS cutoff trends to estimate their chances of clearing the Preliminary Examination. However, the final cutoff will vary depending on this year’s performance and vacancy distribution.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 06:05:23 PM IST

Competition Remains Intense This Year

With only 465 vacancies available and thousands of applicants appearing in the examination, competition for OPSC OCS 2026 remains extremely high. Even small differences in marks could influence qualification chances.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 05:56:01 PM IST

Odisha Administrative Service Aspirants on Alert

Candidates targeting prestigious services such as the Odisha Administrative Service, Odisha Finance Service, and Odisha Revenue Service are closely monitoring result developments and expected qualification trends.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 05:45:27 PM IST

Selection Process Moves to Next Stage

The OPSC OCS recruitment process consists of three stages—Prelims, Mains, and Interview. Candidates qualifying in the Preliminary Examination will advance to the Mains stage, bringing them one step closer to Odisha Civil Services selection.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 05:35:04 PM IST

Mains Exam Notification Expected After Results

Once the prelims result is declared, OPSC is expected to release detailed information regarding the Mains Examination schedule, application process, and examination guidelines for shortlisted candidates.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 05:25:26 PM IST

Two-Paper Prelims Exam Held in June

The OPSC OCS Preliminary Examination 2026 was conducted on 7 June 2026 in two shifts. General Studies Paper I and Paper II were held on the same day across designated examination centres in Odisha.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 05:15:44 PM IST

OPSC Website Witnessing Increased Activity

With the result expected soon, candidates are regularly checking the official OPSC portal for updates. Increased traffic on the website is expected as soon as the commission releases any notification regarding the prelims result.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 05:05:36 PM IST

Candidates Compare Answer Keys and Scores

Following the examination, many aspirants have been estimating their scores using unofficial answer keys. These score estimates are helping candidates assess their chances of qualifying for the OPSC OCS Mains Examination.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 04:55:48 PM IST

Result PDF Likely to Include Qualified Roll Numbers

The OPSC OCS Prelims Result 2026 is expected to be released in PDF format containing the roll numbers of candidates shortlisted for the next stage. Qualified candidates will become eligible to appear for the Main Examination conducted by the commission.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 04:45:26 PM IST

OPSC OCS Mains Preparation Intensifies

Many aspirants have already started preparing for the OPSC OCS Mains Examination without waiting for the prelims result. Candidates are focusing on answer-writing practice, Odisha-specific topics, governance, and current affairs to gain an early advantage.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 04:35:28 PM IST

Candidates Await Cutoff Marks

As the result announcement draws closer, candidates are actively discussing expected cutoff marks. Experts believe the final cutoff will depend on factors such as exam difficulty level, number of vacancies, and overall candidate performance in both papers.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 04:25:59 PM IST

OCS Prelims Conducted for 465 Vacancies

The OPSC OCS Preliminary Examination 2026 was conducted for recruitment to 465 Group A and Group B posts under various Odisha government services. Thousands of candidates participated in the examination held across multiple centres in the state.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 04:23:40 PM IST

OPSC OCS Prelims 2026 Result Expected Soon

The OPSC OCS Prelims Result 2026 is expected to be announced soon on the official website. Candidates who appeared for the Odisha Civil Services Preliminary Examination are eagerly awaiting the result, which will determine eligibility for the Main Examination stage.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 04:22:44 PM IST

OPSC OCS Prelims Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. When will OPSC OCS Prelims Result 2026 be released?

The result is expected to be released in July 2026.

Q2. Where can I check OPSC OCS Prelims Result 2026?

Candidates can check result on the official website @opsc.gov.in.

Q3. What details are mentioned in OPSC OCS Result 2026?

The result PDF contains candidate’s roll number, category, marks obtained and qualifying status.

Q4. What is the next stage after OPSC OCS Prelims Result 2026?

Candidates who qualify prelims exam will be eligible to appear for OPSC OCS Mains exam.

Q5. Will OPSC release Cut Off marks along with result?

Yes Odisha Public Service Commission will release category wise cut off along with result.
